clauses.name: Pray the Ether
clauses.printedParagraph: Discard a card from your hand. If you do, draw 2 cards.
clauses.expectedBehavior: Discard exactly one available hand card before requesting two draws; empty hand cannot pay. Respect draw locks, opponent Kanon, Recovery exclusions, one event per batch and independent nested discard/draw sequences.

clauses.name: Alchemical Press
clauses.printedParagraph: Whenever you play a Will, you can discard a card. If you do, draw a card.
clauses.expectedBehavior: An own Will play offers an optional discard, then one draw; decline or unavailable/immune hand cannot force a choice. Recheck at resolution and legacy acceptance; pending effect survives source departure and cannot draw twice. Common draw restrictions apply.

clauses.name: Martyrize
clauses.printedParagraph: As an additional cost to play this Will, reveal and exile a manifestation from your hand. Draw a number of cards equal to the base power of the revealed manifestation, then exile this Will.
clauses.expectedBehavior: Reveal and exile a hand Manifestation as an additional cost before responses. Request draws equal to its base power, honor draw locks and opponent Kanon; replacement does not refund the donor or prevent the Will's exile. Reject a non-Manifestation atomically.
